name: @eeyzs1/dsh-llm-transport-recovery
description: Two-phase recovery for DeepSeek TRANSPORT failures: 5 normal HTTP/1.1 retries within a 2-min window, then a recovery path (fresh DNS + all-IP fallback + brand-new connections) up to a bounded budget (5+15=20 total), then the turn fails like stock DSH. Phase is tracked per session so one session's success cannot reset another's counter. Logs full error chains for diagnosis.
